# Tasks Document

- [ ] 1. Define Agentic RAG Protobuf contracts (state/config/evidence/citations/answer event)
  - Files:
    - `src/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Core/Messages/agentic_rag_messages.proto` (new)
    - `src/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Core/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Core.csproj` (modify)
  - Add Protobuf messages for `AgenticRagState`, `AgenticRagConfig`, `RagEvidenceSummary`, `RagCitation`, and `AgenticRagAnswerEvent` (MVP schema from design; keep fields bounded and extensible)
  - Wire the proto into `AI.Core.csproj` via `<Protobuf Include="Messages\agentic_rag_messages.proto" GrpcServices="None" />`
  - Purpose: Establish cross-runtime, versionable contracts (Protobuf-first) for Agentic RAG state and output
  - _Leverage: `src/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Core/ai_messages.proto`, `src/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Core/WithTool/tool_messages.proto`, `src/Aevatar.Agents.Abstractions/memory.proto`, `src/Aevatar.Agents.Abstractions/memory_vector.proto`_
  - _Requirements: 1, 3, 5, 8_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec agentic-rag-gagent, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Protobuf + C# contract engineer | Task: Add `agentic_rag_messages.proto` for Agentic RAG MVP contracts (state/config/evidence/citation/answer event) and wire it into `Aevatar.Agents.AI.Core.csproj`. Keep schema bounded and forward-compatible. | Restrictions: All cross-boundary types MUST be Protobuf; do not add any JSON-string “contracts”; do not introduce port 5000 anywhere; keep messages minimal; follow proto evolution rules (no renumber/reuse). | _Leverage: existing `ai_messages.proto`, `tool_messages.proto`, `memory*.proto` patterns | _Requirements: 1,3,5,8 | Success: `dotnet build` generates code for the new proto and compilation succeeds. Workflow: mark this task as [-] before coding; after completion call log-implementation for task 1 and then mark it [x].

- [ ] 2. Add Agentic RAG core models and retriever abstraction
  - Files:
    - `src/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Core/AgenticRag/AgenticRagModels.cs` (new)
    - `src/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Core/AgenticRag/IAgenticRagRetriever.cs` (new)
  - Define minimal C# request/response types for in-process calls (e.g., `AgenticRagRequest`, `AgenticRagResponse`, `RagDiagnostics`, `RagBudget`, `RagStopReason`)
  - Define `IAgenticRagRetriever.RetrieveAsync(...)` returning a normalized evidence list (Protobuf-backed `RagEvidenceSummary` objects)
  - Purpose: Separate the framework-owned loop from retrieval backends; keep in-process types lightweight (DI boundary)
  - _Leverage: `src/Aevatar.Agents.Abstractions/Memory/IMemoryStore.cs`, `src/Aevatar.Agents.Abstractions/Memory/IMemoryVectorIndex.cs`_
  - _Requirements: 1, 2, 5_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec agentic-rag-gagent, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: C# API designer | Task: Add `AgenticRagModels.cs` with minimal in-process request/response/diagnostics/budget types, and define `IAgenticRagRetriever` that returns normalized Protobuf evidence summaries. Ensure names are stable and allocations bounded. | Restrictions: Do not define any cross-runtime state/events in C# (use proto only); avoid deep nesting/giant files; no port 5000; keep each file single-responsibility. | _Leverage: existing DI-boundary interfaces like `IMemoryVectorIndex` | _Requirements: 1,2,5 | Success: Models compile, and retriever abstraction is usable without pulling in any concrete backend. Workflow: mark this task as [-] before coding; after completion call log-implementation for task 2 and then mark it [x].

- [ ] 3. Add Planner / Synthesizer / Critic role interfaces (strategy objects)
  - Files:
    - `src/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Core/AgenticRag/IAgenticRagPlanner.cs` (new)
    - `src/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Core/AgenticRag/IAgenticRagSynthesizer.cs` (new)
    - `src/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Core/AgenticRag/IAgenticRagCritic.cs` (new)
  - Define the “four roles” as pluggable strategies used by the loop (planner produces retrieval intents; synthesizer produces answer draft + selected evidence; critic produces pass/fail + gaps/next hints)
  - Purpose: Allow one Agent (`AgenticRagGAgent`) to “role-play internally” while still supporting advanced users swapping logic/components
  - _Leverage: `src/Aevatar.Agents.AI.WithProcessStrategy/*` (strategy pattern), `src/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Core/AIGAgentBase.Hooks.cs` (governed LLM calls)_
  - _Requirements: 1, 4_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec agentic-rag-gagent, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Framework architect | Task: Define `IAgenticRagPlanner/IAgenticRagSynthesizer/IAgenticRagCritic` interfaces with minimal inputs/outputs that support iterative RAG without forcing multi-agent decomposition. | Restrictions: Keep interfaces minimal and deterministic; no cross-boundary types in C#; no port 5000; avoid over-engineering. | _Leverage: WithProcessStrategy patterns and AI.Core hook pipeline entrypoints | _Requirements: 1,4 | Success: Interfaces compile and enable a loop implementation to swap planner/synthesizer/critic independently. Workflow: mark this task as [-] before coding; after completion call log-implementation for task 3 and then mark it [x].

- [ ] 4. Implement default Retriever: MemoryStore + VectorIndex (semantic-first, lexical fallback)
  - File: `src/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Core/AgenticRag/MemoryStoreAgenticRagRetriever.cs` (new)
  - Implement a reference retriever using:
    - `IMemoryVectorIndex.SearchAsync` when embeddings are available
    - fallback to `IMemoryStore.SearchAsync` when vector search unavailable/empty
  - Output `RagEvidenceSummary` with bounded `snippet` and `MemoryEntryCitation` (scope/memoryId/entryId)
  - Purpose: Provide an out-of-the-box retriever that works with existing Aevatar memory primitives
  - _Leverage: `src/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Core/AIGAgentBase.MemoryStore.cs` (memory scope conventions), `src/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Core/WithTool/Tools/BuiltIn/AevatarMemorySearchTool.cs` (semantic rerank patterns)_
  - _Requirements: 2, 3, 5_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec agentic-rag-gagent, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Retrieval engineer (C#) | Task: Create `MemoryStoreAgenticRagRetriever` that performs semantic-first retrieval via `IMemoryVectorIndex` and lexical fallback via `IMemoryStore`, producing bounded `RagEvidenceSummary` + citations. | Restrictions: No unbounded loops/allocations; never store huge content; do not leak secrets into tags/diagnostics; no port 5000. | _Leverage: memory scope/id conventions from `AIGAgentBase.MemoryStore.cs` and semantic patterns from `AevatarMemorySearchTool` | _Requirements: 2,3,5 | Success: Retriever returns deterministic, bounded evidence with correct citations, and gracefully degrades when embeddings/index are unavailable. Workflow: mark this task as [-] before coding; after completion call log-implementation for task 4 and then mark it [x].

- [ ] 5. Implement `AgenticRagGAgent` loop skeleton (bounded iterations + evidence + citations + answer event)
  - File: `src/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Core/AgenticRag/AgenticRagGAgent.cs` (new)
  - Implement `AnswerAsync(AgenticRagRequest, ct)` that runs: Plan → Retrieve → Synthesize → Critique with strict stop/budget enforcement
  - Use `GenerateLLMWithHooksAsync` for internal LLM calls and default to “no tools attached” (avoid recursive tool loops)
  - Produce `AgenticRagAnswerEvent` (PublishAsync) and update `CustomState` summary (`AgenticRagState`) best-effort
  - Purpose: Deliver the framework-owned Agentic RAG control loop that users can derive from or compose
  - _Leverage: `src/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Core/AIGAgentBase.Hooks.cs`, `src/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Core/AIGAgentBase.Chat.cs` (event publishing patterns), `src/Aevatar.Agents.Core/Telemetry/WorkflowTelemetry.cs`_
  - _Requirements: 1, 3, 4, 5, 6_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec agentic-rag-gagent, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: AI.Core framework maintainer | Task: Implement `AgenticRagGAgent` with a bounded, framework-owned Agentic RAG loop (plan/retrieve/synthesize/critic) that emits `AgenticRagAnswerEvent`, enforces budgets/stop reasons, and never enters infinite loops. Use the hook pipeline for LLM calls but do not attach tools by default. | Restrictions: Cross-boundary state/event MUST be Protobuf; no port 5000; keep file under 800 lines; avoid >3 nesting; best-effort failure handling with clear diagnostics. | _Leverage: AIGAgentBase hook + publish patterns; WorkflowTelemetry for step spans | _Requirements: 1,3,4,5,6 | Success: Loop runs deterministically under tests, outputs citations/diagnostics, and publishes a final answer event with bounded evidence. Workflow: mark this task as [-] before coding; after completion call log-implementation for task 5 and then mark it [x].

- [ ] 6. Add ExecutionTrace integration + update AI.Core architecture docs (architecture change)
  - Files:
    - `src/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Core/AgenticRag/AgenticRagGAgent.cs` (modify)
    - `src/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Core/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` (modify)
  - Add optional `IExecutionTraceStore` injection hook (`ExecutionTraceStore` writable property) and emit a bounded `ExecutionTrace` tree for the RAG run when enabled
  - Update `AI.Core` architecture doc to include the new `AgenticRag/` directory and its responsibilities
  - Purpose: Make Agentic RAG observable/replayable and keep architecture documentation in sync (required by repo rules)
  - _Leverage: `src/Aevatar.Agents.Abstractions/execution_trace.proto`, `src/Aevatar.Agents.Core/Helpers/ExecutionTraceStoreInjector.cs`, `src/Aevatar.Agents.Cognitive/Agents/CognitiveCoordinatorGAgent.Workflow.cs` (trace saving patterns)_
  - _Requirements: 6, 8_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec agentic-rag-gagent, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Observability + tracing engineer | Task: Integrate `ExecutionTrace` emission into `AgenticRagGAgent` (bounded nodes per iteration/phase) using injected `IExecutionTraceStore`, and update `AI.Core/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` to document the new `AgenticRag/` module. | Restrictions: Do not dump large payloads into trace; best-effort store failures must not break the main flow; no port 5000; keep docs concise and accurate. | _Leverage: ExecutionTraceStoreInjector and Cognitive workflow trace saving patterns | _Requirements: 6,8 | Success: RAG runs produce a bounded trace when enabled, and docs reflect the new module layout. Workflow: mark this task as [-] before coding; after completion call log-implementation for task 6 and then mark it [x].

- [ ] 7. Unit tests: loop stop conditions, budget enforcement, and critic “bounce back”
  - Files:
    - `test/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Core.Tests/AgenticRag/AgenticRagLoopTests.cs` (new)
    - `test/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Core.Tests/TestAgents/AgenticRagTestAgent.cs` (new)
  - Test deterministic behavior using fake planner/retriever/synthesizer/critic implementations (no network, no real LLM)
  - Cover: max iterations, no evidence, critic fail → continue, budget exhaustion → stop with diagnostics
  - Purpose: Lock down the control loop semantics independent of any LLM provider
  - _Leverage: existing test patterns in `test/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Core.Tests/*`, `Hooks/*Tests.cs` for best-effort assertions_
  - _Requirements: 1, 4, 5, 7_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec agentic-rag-gagent, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: QA engineer for .NET framework | Task: Add deterministic xUnit tests for Agentic RAG loop semantics (stop reasons, budget enforcement, critic-driven continuation) using fake role strategies and a simple test agent. | Restrictions: No network/LLM; keep tests deterministic; do not delete failing tests; no port usage. | _Leverage: AI.Core.Tests patterns and existing fake helpers | _Requirements: 1,4,5,7 | Success: Tests reliably validate loop behavior and pass in CI. Workflow: mark this task as [-] before coding; after completion call log-implementation for task 7 and then mark it [x].

- [ ] 8. Unit tests: MemoryStore retriever behavior (semantic-first, lexical fallback, citation integrity)
  - File: `test/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Core.Tests/AgenticRag/MemoryStoreAgenticRagRetrieverTests.cs` (new)
  - Cover:
    - vector index available → semantic results with similarity score
    - vector index empty/unavailable → lexical fallback
    - citations include correct scope/memoryId/entryId and snippets are bounded
  - Purpose: Ensure the default retriever is correct, bounded, and safe
  - _Leverage: `test/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Core.Tests/MemorySearchSemanticTests.cs` (stubs + patterns), `src/Aevatar.Agents.Core/Memory/InMemoryMemoryStore.cs`_
  - _Requirements: 2, 3, 5, 7_

Reuse existing in-memory store/index patterns from AI.Core.Tests. | Restrictions: Deterministic; no external dependencies; no port usage; test both happy and error paths. | _Leverage: MemorySearchSemanticTests helpers and InMemoryMemoryStore | _Requirements: 2,3,5,7 | Success: Retriever tests pass and prevent regressions in evidence/citation correctness.   - File: `src/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Core/docs/AGENTIC_RAG.md` (new)
  - Document:
    - What Agentic RAG is in Aevatar terms (single agent, role strategies, bounded loop)
    - How to use `AgenticRagGAgent` and configure budgets
    - How to plug a custom retriever / swap planner/synthesizer/critic
    - Output format: citations + diagnostics + (optional) execution trace link
  - Purpose: Make the framework feature discoverable and usable without reading source
  - _Leverage: `src/Aevatar.Agents.AI.Core/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/AEVATAR_FRAMEWORK_GUIDE.md`_
